job.title: Software Engineer 3
job.workplace: Hybrid (candidates based in New York City)

details.about: MongoDB's Application Modernization Platform (AMP) helps organizations move legacy applications and their data from relational databases to MongoDB. The Agentic Integrations team builds the interfaces that let AMP capabilities be discovered, invoked and orchestrated from AI agents and development environments: consistent tool and API surfaces, correct authentication and execution context, and integrations that are observable and safe to operate.
duties: Design and implement agent- and developer-facing integrations for AMP services, including tool definitions, API clients and adapters
Define clear input and output contracts, with validation, error semantics and behavior for malformed or partly successful calls
Carry authentication, authorization and tenant context across integration boundaries so agent calls never exceed the user's privileges
Build instrumentation for agent-driven traffic: structured logs, traces, latency and failure metrics, and diagnostics
Write production-quality code with unit, integration and end-to-end tests, including tests for nondeterministic model behavior
Diagnose failures across service, tool and model boundaries to root cause
Contribute to shared SDKs, command-line tools and agent frameworks used by other teams
Join code and design reviews, interview candidates and mentor engineers and interns
needs: At least four years building and operating production software services
Proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, Java or TypeScript, and the judgment to work in more than one
Experience designing APIs or service interfaces, including versioning, error handling and backward compatibility
Practical experience with authentication and authorization such as OAuth, API keys or service-to-service identity
Experience with automated testing, continuous delivery and debugging distributed systems
Strong written and verbal technical communication
A collaborative approach and realistic judgment of project complexity and delivery risk
nice: Building tool or integration surfaces for AI agents or large language models
Experience with the Model Context Protocol or a similar agent-to-tool standard
Shipping developer tooling such as CLIs, SDKs or local servers in customer-managed environments
Familiarity with application modernization, relational databases, MongoDB or automated code transformation
Working with customers or field teams on integration and deployment issues
Mentoring engineers or interns and helping with technical hiring
details.benefits: Base salary $106,000 – $209,000 a year in the U.S.; offers depend on skills, experience, qualifications and work location. Other benefits for eligible U.S. employees may include equity, an employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks of fully paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, a 401(k) plan, mental health counseling and health benefits.
notes: Looking for candidates based in New York City for MongoDB's hybrid working model
Candidates with more relevant experience may be considered for more senior roles
Accommodations for candidates with disabilities: tell your recruiter

scenes.head: What you'll do
lines: You'll design and build integrations for agents and developers, with clear input and output contracts and solid error handling.

You'll add logs, traces, and metrics, write thorough tests, track failures to their root cause, and help review code and mentor engineers and interns.

Plus automated testing, continuous delivery, and debugging distributed systems.
Experience building tools for A I agents, or with the Model Context Protocol, is a plus.
